subject: Mutual action plan & accelerated POC enablement: environment checklist and timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@medilytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan & accelerated POC enablement: environment checklist and timeline

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m attaching a short mutual action plan (MAP) oriented toward an accelerated POC so your engineers can hit early performance tests by week 2. This thread is to align on the exact environment steps we need to close out before we switch to live test traffic. Key items we need from Medilytics to unblock Redwood Dedicated test runs: 

- Org setup: a tenant / org name to seed in our onboarding portal (we recommend medilytics-prod-poc) and an admin contact.
- API keys: request two ephemeral API keys for staging (read-only for the first 48 hours, then elevated for full eval). We will provide a one-click key rotation guide.
- IP allowlist: WAN egress ranges to allow; we need a /28 for the first test ramp and will provide the exact CIDRs once you confirm.
- VPC peering / routing: optional but recommended for higher throughput tests. If you want peering, please share your VPC id, region, and preferred peering window.

Proposed timeline (accelerated):
- Day 0 (today): Confirm org name + admin + dev contacts.
- Day 1: Provide staging API key request + IP range OR schedule peering window.
- Day 2–3: Networking allowlist applied; we provision tenant and seed credentials.
- Day 4–10: Load, latency, and quality runs (we’ll run shared eval harness).

I’ve attached the MAP-Accelerated-POC-Checklist.pdf and a sample network diagram. Can you confirm owners for the org setup and who on your side will authorize peering? If you want, we can run a 30-minute technical sync tomorrow at 10am PT to walk infra steps.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP-Accelerated-POC-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf), medilytics-network-diagram.png (image/png)

From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@medilytics.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@medilytics.io>, Vikram Rao <vikram@medilytics.io>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & accelerated POC enablement: environment checklist and timeline

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

- Org name: confirmed as medilytics-eval (we use -eval for temporary tenants). Admin owner: Vikram Rao (vikram@medilytics.io).
- API keys: We prefer that Redwood creates the initial ephemeral keys and we approve via our portal. Can you send the key creation link?
- IP allowlist: Our networking team prefers explicit CIDRs. We can open a /28 from our outbound NAT (13.45.64.0/28) for the initial ramp. Please confirm that matches your expected source set.
- VPC peering: We’re open, but need to check with cloud ops about cross-account peering windows. If peering introduces delays, we’ll start with IP allowlist and move to peering in week 2.

We can do the 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10am PT — Vikram will join for networking.

One ask: can you include the exact token lifecycle steps in the MAP (creation, rotate, revoke) — our security team wants to map to our rotation policy.

Thanks,
Asha
Head of Platform | Medilytics
asha.kapoor@medilytics.io

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@medilytics.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & accelerated POC enablement: environment checklist and timeline

Thanks Asha — noted. Short answers and next steps from engineering side: 

- API key flow: We’ll generate staging ephemeral keys from the Redwood Console and surface a single-use approval link in the email. Keys will be TTL-limited (48h) by default; we can extend if you approve. Rotation: we’ll show key rotation steps in the MAP doc and provide a one-click rotate URL. Revocation: immediate via the Console / API. I’ll attach a small token-lifecycle snippet to the MAP before tomorrow’s sync.
- IP ranges: The single /28 (13.45.64.0/28) is OK for initial runs — we will also source-balance across our regional egress in us-west-2 for low-latency.
- VPC peering: optional. If you submit the VPC id (e.g., vpc-0a1b2c3d) and preferred peer window we’ll prepare the CloudFormation handshake template to speed approval.

Operational checklist we’ll cover in the sync: seed tenant provisioning, service-account roles, key handoff, KV cache prewarm, and the first evaluation harness run (latency + 99th percentile token tail).

Vanessa — I’m happy to run through the token lifecycle and the short runbook in tomorrow’s call.

Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment stub: token-lifecycle-snippet.txt (text/plain)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@medilytics.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Infra Team <infra@medilytics.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & accelerated POC enablement: environment checklist and timeline

Asha / Vikram / Infra —

Thanks for the confirmations. Quick recap and explicit asks so we all have the same timeline: 

1) Owners
- Medilytics org admin: Vikram Rao (vikram@medilytics.io) — will approve keys and peering.
- Medilytics networking: infra@medilytics.io — will apply IP allowlist (13.45.64.0/28) tomorrow morning.
- Redwood provisioning: Vanessa (account lead) + Ben (SRE) — we’ll seed the tenant after allowlist is confirmed.

2) Action items (concrete)
- Medilytics: confirm VPC id if you want peering (otherwise we proceed with allowlist only).
- Medilytics: confirm approval for the 48h TTL ephemeral keys or request custom TTL.
- Redwood: provide the one-click key approval link and token lifecycle snippet before EOD tomorrow.

3) Schedule
- Tomorrow 10:00am PT: technical sync (30m) — cover allowlist validation and key handoff.
- Fri Day 2: we provision tenant, hand off keys, and run the first smoke flow.
- Week 1–2: run spikes and quality evals; plan go/no-go at end of week 2.

If everyone confirms in this thread, I’ll mark the MAP as accepted in HubSpot and attach a short runbook for the sync. Thanks again — excited to get you into a production-like eval quickly.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-2026-1182, Doc: https://redwood-drive.company/rdw/medilytics/poceval-v1.docx
